pattern.description: With the Integration Management submenu open, the cursor sweeps upward through the list; each row it passes gets a grey hover band, until it settles on Run Tasks.
pattern.why_premium: The visible hover trail shows the viewer where the cursor is heading and previews the menu's options on the way, so the navigation reads as deliberate guidance instead of a jump-cut to the target.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.cursor', {y: -400, x: 50, duration: 0.85, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); hover band driven by the cursor's y: in an onUpdate, gsap.set the row under the cursor to backgroundColor '#eceef1' and clear the others (no tween, step change), ending on '.row.run-tasks'.
build_hint.remotion: cursorY = interpolate(frame, [0, 26], [startY, endY], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); hoveredRow = Math.floor((cursorY - listTop) / rowHeight); each row background = i === hoveredRow ? '#eceef1' : 'transparent'. No spring.

notes: Hover trail rows are listed on the union box b02 because rows other than Run Tasks have no candidate boxes and none end highlighted (the text field lists the rows hovered in the filmstrip, not one string). Burst ends as the narrator finishes 'April.'
